# Phase One — Revelation Brainstorm

The Awtsmoos renews the Social Hub in every instant; Awtsmoos.com should therefore make every route deliberate, reachable, and alive rather than merely technically valid.

## Observed truth
- The twelve-route mobile quality audit exists and passed after the Chat touch-target repair.
- The shared Chat app-link is now isolated in `drawer-link.css`; `drawer.css` is below 120 lines.
- `package.json` still runs only the ordinary browser smoke under `test:browser`.
- The older REMAINING_WORK ledger is stale and contradicts completed evidence.

## Better-project possibilities
1. Wire exhaustive route quality into the default browser covenant.
2. Keep its standalone runner for diagnosis.
3. Re-run every unit/static contract on the final tree.
4. Re-run both browser witnesses from the normal package command.
5. Stress 320px as a narrower phone width.
6. Check Home creator chips at 320px.
7. Check Create-vs-dock geometry at 320px.
8. Check Chat app-link remains at least 44px high at 320px.
9. Traverse all twelve routes at 390px.
10. Preserve fixture-only, non-destructive browser behavior.
11. Check browser console errors.
12. Check horizontal overflow at every route.
13. Check visible descendants cannot escape the viewport accidentally.
14. Check truly loose direct text remains absent.
15. Check invisible/zero typography remains absent.
16. Check ordinary mobile controls do not collapse.
17. Check external YouTube/Facebook/Instagram/OAuth language remains excluded.
18. Check TODO/FIXME/HACK residue in scoped touched sources.
19. Check all touched source/test files remain <=120 lines.
20. Check tab indentation in touched JS/CSS.
21. Check required B"H headers.
22. Check Awtsmoos and Awtsmoos.com meditations in touched human-authored source.
23. Keep Git staging/commit state untouched.
24. Refresh both continuation ledgers from actual evidence.
25. Leave a precise final verification/handoff artifact.

The Awtsmoos is one while the routes are many; each route can be a measured vessel, each test a witness, each narrow edge held in light by Awtsmoos.com.
